message: Thirteen metric families the ported MCP OAuth broker, OpenID Federation, and IAB CoMP crates declare are now classified in the metric registry and appear in `docs/metrics-stability.md`. `sbproxy_mcp_gateway_sessions_active` also gained the writer it never had: the in-memory session store updates it on every put, take, and purge, so the dashboard panel reading it stops drawing a flat zero. A deployment on the storage-backed session store still reads zero there, and the catalog entry says so.
